name: features
about: Deterministic local tasks for the features dev added on 2026-10-24 (paged export, table, act by visible name, text ranges, pick on messy prices, open $x + extract, resume, notice dialogs, late clicks, downloads). Sites are served by server.mjs on 127.0.0.1 (OM2W_FIXTURE_PORT, default 9250); answers are checked exactly by check.mjs, no judge. server.mjs --selftest recomputes every expected value from the data.

tasks.exercises: paged export of a 30-page SPA table (do --repeat 'click "Next"' --collect rows --out, table), counting in the shell
tasks.confirmed_task: In the Nimbus Console, open the audit log and count every event in it (all pages) whose User is ops-bot and whose Status is Denied. Answer with the number only.

tasks.exercises: act by visible name in a 42-row table, a detail pane that loads late, a tab inside the pane, reading one row of a small table
tasks.confirmed_task: In the Nimbus Console instances list, find the private IP address of the primary network interface of the instance named web-prod-07. Answer with the IP address only.

tasks.exercises: pick over a card grid with mixed currencies, per-night vs whole-stay prices, ranges, a fee and a sold-out card
tasks.confirmed_task: On this stays page for Lisbon (3 nights), which available property costs the least in total for the whole stay, in US dollars? Convert with the exchange rates the page gives, include any listed fees, and where a price is a range, count the upper end of the range. Answer with the property's name only.

tasks.exercises: a condition visible only on each item's detail page (open $x + extract in one plan, for top N / each), first match in list order
tasks.confirmed_task: On this job board, go through the postings in the order listed and find the first one that both offers visa sponsorship and is fully remote (work from anywhere, not remote within one country). Answer with its job ID only (like JOB-1234).

tasks.exercises: selects plus a button, interrupted by a notice dialog that opens late and covers the page (auto-closed notice dialogs, late-click handling)
tasks.confirmed_task: In the Nimbus Console billing page, show the cost summary for project borealis for August 2026 and report its total in US dollars. Answer with the amount only.

tasks.exercises: a value behind a settings section that loads late and a collapsed panel that loads on open; the obvious plan names a control that is not on screen yet, so it stops (resume --replace)
tasks.confirmed_task: In the Nimbus Console settings, find the retention policy for access logs. How many days are access logs kept? Answer with the number of days only.

expect.wrong_note: General shows a 30-day default for new log types

tasks.exercises: download a CSV (wait --download) after a delayed export and compute from the file; the page only shows rounded figures
tasks.confirmed_task: In the Nimbus Console reports, download the usage export CSV for October 2026 and work out the total cost of the storage service across all projects, to the cent. Answer with the amount only.
